name: Commission Policy Research
description: Spend Office Funds to increase one randomly-selected Party-tier booster group's relationship. Available once per Office screen; resets after completion of a level (success or failure).
bonus_condition_1: Policy Research Assistant is Tier 1: +1 to the selected Party booster group.
bonus_condition_2: Policy Research Assistant is Tier 2: +2 to the selected Party booster group.

name: Commission Press Engagement
description: Spend Office Funds to increase one randomly-selected National-tier booster group's relationship. Available once per Office screen; resets after completion of a level (success or failure).
bonus_condition_1: Media Spokesperson is Tier 1: +2 to the selected National booster group.
bonus_condition_2: Media Spokesperson is Tier 2: +4 to the selected National booster group.

name: Commission District Engagement
description: Spend Office Funds to increase one randomly-selected Constituency-tier booster group's relationship. Available once per Office screen; resets after completion of a level.
bonus_condition_1: District Representative is Tier 1: +2 to the selected Constituency booster group.
bonus_condition_2: District Representative is Tier 2: +4 to the selected Constituency booster group.

name: “ね3” Coffee
description: One-use item. Grants +1 energy for the first stage of the next level played.

name: “ミレニ姫” Tea
description: One-use item. Grants +1 gaffe (失言) counter cap for the first stage of the next level played.

name: Paperwork Automation
description: One-use item. Grants +1 card drawn for the first stage of the next level played.

name: Wristwatch
description: One-use item. Grants +1 turn for the first stage of the next level played.

name: Meditation Session
description: One-use item. Grants +1 guard for the first stage of the next level played.

description: Cosmetic character profile appearance package. Placeholder; will be replaced by character art later.

description: Cosmetic Office background appearance package. Placeholder; will be replaced by artwork later.

name: Unlock Tier 1 Level
description: Base cost to open a Tier 1 level for play.

name: Unlock Tier 2 Level
description: Base cost to open a Tier 2 level for play.

name: Unlock Random Tier 1 Card
description: Unlocks one new Tier 1 card at random, making it available for the deck.
bonus_condition_1: Unlocked card must still be purchased with Funds (Yen) before entering the deck.

name: Unlock Random Tier 2 Card
description: Unlocks one new Tier 2 card at random, making it available for the deck.
bonus_condition_1: Unlocked card must still be purchased with Funds (Yen) before entering the deck.

name: Unlock Random Tier 3 Card
description: Unlocks one new Tier 3 card at random, making it available for the deck.
bonus_condition_1: Unlocked card must still be purchased with Funds (Yen) before entering the deck.

name: Unlock New Staff Recruitment Tier
description: Unlocks the next tier of staff recruitment, allowing higher-tier staff hires.

name: Increase Office Funds Cap
description: Increases the Office Funds cap by 100,000円. Repeatable.

name: Extra Draw (Level Buff)
description: One-use buff applied for the entire duration of the next level played: +1 card drawn.
bonus_condition_1: Stackable up to +2 total per level; each additional stack costs another 50 XP.

name: Extra Energy (Level Buff)
description: One-use buff applied for the entire duration of the next level played: +1 energy.
bonus_condition_1: Stackable up to +3 total per level; each additional stack costs another 60 XP.

name: Extra Guard (Level Buff)
description: One-use buff applied for the entire duration of the next level played: +1 guard.
bonus_condition_1: Stackable up to +5 total per level; each additional stack costs another 70 XP.

name: Extra Gaffe Counter Cap (Level Buff)
description: One-use buff applied for the entire duration of the next level played: +1 gaffe (失言) counter cap.
bonus_condition_1: Stackable up to +5 total per level; each additional stack costs another 80 XP.

name: Extra Turn (Level Buff)
description: One-use buff applied for the entire duration of the next level played: +1 turn on the stage clock.
bonus_condition_1: Stackable up to +3 total per level; each additional stack costs another 100 XP.

name: Host National Booster Dinner
description: Host a dinner for a player-selected National-tier booster group.

name: Host District Walking Tour
description: Host a walking tour for a player-selected Constituency-tier booster group.

name: Purchase Random Tier 1 Card
description: Purchases one new Tier 1 card at random from Tier 1 cards previously unlocked, making it available for the deck.

name: Purchase Random Tier 2 Card
description: Purchases one new Tier 2 card at random from Tier 2 cards previously unlocked, making it available for the deck.

name: Purchase Random Tier 3 Card
description: Purchases one new Tier 3 card at random from Tier 3 cards previously unlocked, making it available for the deck.
